sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Anxious and restless ; dull headache. Tongue
coated.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Burning sensation, better cold application.
Thirst, better vomiting.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Tenderness of liver. Profuse, bilious
stool, with nausea. Constipation.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Thirst, before and during chill and heat;
better vomiting at close of chill; sweat not marked.
